note: From the 2026-08-05 deepening pass, whose brief was to turn the prazskestromy.cz centre route (Karlovo namesti to Hellichova, 3.7 km) into a genuine walk. Leads failed only our evidence bar, the age bar or the count; blocked can never ship as they stand. Sources: the USOP register as transcribed in the Czech Wikipedia list, the Agentura Koniklec printed maps of both tiers (mapa-sz.pdf and mapa-jz.pdf, girths as of 2017), and prazskestromy.cz, which is all rights reserved and was used for verification only.

leads.name: Ustredni lipa republiky na Male Strane
leads.why: Vyznamny strom 31, 247 cm, on the Ujezd corridor near the Jan Neruda monument, so squarely on the centre route where we most need density. Planted 28 October 1968 by the nature conservation corps of the National Museum Society under Otakar Leisky, who set off the planting of roughly a thousand more across Czechoslovakia; this is the central one of that thousand. Ten weeks after Warsaw Pact tanks arrived, which makes the date the story. Failed on one thing only: it is 58 years old, which would make it by far the youngest tree on a page whose next youngest is 125. Reconsider if the site ever grows a category for historically planted trees, because the story is better than that of several trees we publish.

leads.name: Platan u kostela sv. Klimenta (Nove Mlyny)
leads.why: Pamatny strom, 342 cm in 2017, on the corner of Nove Mlyny and Klimentska opposite the church of St Clement, on a public street. It stands 250 metres from the Rasnovka oak (prg_016), so the two make a genuine two-tree pocket in the Petrska quarter and it would be the cheapest possible eleventh tree. Failed on the count and on repetition: the page already carries four London planes and a fifth adds a species, not a reason to walk. Its register note claims nothing beyond being a local dominant of above average size and age, so it needs a story before it needs a pin.

leads.name: Turecka liska na Petrine
leads.why: A Turkish hazel of 256 cm by the Stefanik Observatory on Petrin, inside the Seminarska zahrada and Kinsky cluster where we already publish three trees. Its memorial-tree status was revoked on 28 February 2007 and the register does not say why, which is the whole lead: revocation usually means the tree died or was felled, but sometimes it means a boundary or ownership change. One check of whether it still stands, and of the reason given in the revocation decision, either kills it or produces a well placed fourth tree for the Petrin walk.

leads.name: Lipa srdcita u krizovniku
leads.why: Vyznamny strom 69, 289 cm, in the courtyard of the Knights of the Cross monastery at the Old Town end of Charles Bridge, which is about as central as a tree can get. Blocked in practice rather than in principle: no source read this pass says whether the courtyard is open to visitors, and hard rule 10 says leave it out until that is answered. One fetch of the order's own visiting information decides it.

leads.name: Jilm vaz v Michelskem lese
leads.why: Pamatny strom, 375 cm, on the yellow waymarked path southeast of the Labut pond, called the only memorial elm in Prague by the 2020 Koniklec map, a claim that predates the protection of the Ruzova elm in 2022. Bigger than the elm we are publishing, but 6 km southeast of the centre in woodland, so it joins nothing. Keep for a future Michelsky les cluster together with the two giant sequoias on the same path, which would make a real forest walk rather than a lone pin.

leads.name: Duby letni na Pavim vrchu
leads.why: Three memorial oaks of 270 to 410 cm on Na Plani in Smichov, the surviving remnant of the hill's original woodland, 1.5 km south of the route. Recorded as a group of three rather than one identifiable tree, so as it stands it fails the collectible-point test. If a future pass can establish which of the three is the largest and give it its own position, that one alone would qualify.

leads.name: Platan javorolisty v parku Jezerka
leads.why: Pamatny strom, 525 cm, below the Divadlo na Jezerce in Nusle, predating the park built around it from 1949. Big enough to matter and in a public park, but it is a fifth plane in a city whose page is already plane-heavy and it sits alone 3 km southeast of everything else. A candidate for a Nusle and Vinohrady cluster, not for the centre.

leads.name: Jilm Na Zatorach v Holesovicich
leads.why: Vyznamny strom 28, 266 cm, by the bus turning circle at Nadrazi Holesovice, the last trace of the Zatory quarter that was demolished in 1978. A good story about a place rather than about a tree, and 4 km from the centre, but it would join the Stromovka and Cisarsky ostrov pair (prg_006 and prg_007) into a three-stop northern walk.

leads.name: Moruse v ulici Nad Hradnim vodojemem
leads.why: Vyznamny strom 19, 255 cm, in Stresovice, recorded as the largest white mulberry in Prague. A species we do not have anywhere in the city and a genuine July fruit peak, which the season radar is short of. Failed on position: it stands in a residential street 3 km west of the centre with nothing else near it, and on evidence, since no second source was looked for this pass.

blocked.name: Frantiskansky tis (the Franciscan yew)
blocked.reason: The register itself says the rajsky dvur at the church of Our Lady of the Snows is not normally open and states plainly that the tree is inaccessible to the public. Planted in 1603 at the founding of the monastery garden, the oldest woody plant in the city centre, and it holds a sandstone statuette of the Madonna inside its hollow, so this is the single best tree the centre has and it can never be published while its courtyard stays shut.

blocked.name: Jinan na Novem Meste (Panska 3)
blocked.reason: Grows in the inner courtyard of a secondary technical school on Panska street. Not publicly accessible, so hard rule 10 excludes it whatever its 277 cm trunk and its link to the naturalist teacher Karel Slavoj Amerling are worth.

blocked.name: Lipa Vaclava Havla, Maltezske namesti
blocked.reason: On the centre route, and not a tree in our sense: a 58 cm American lime growing up through the round table of the first Vaclav Havel bench in the country, installed in 2014. The bench is the destination, the tree is its furniture.

blocked.name: Lipa Jana Nerudy na Ujezdu
blocked.reason: On the centre route, but planted in 1984 for the 150th anniversary of Neruda's birth and 140 cm around. Forty-two years old, which is not a tree this site sends anyone to see.

blocked.name: Lipa republiky v Klementinu
blocked.reason: Planted 5 November 1968 under the Klementinum astronomical tower, 116 cm. Too young, and inside a library complex whose courtyards keep their own hours.

blocked.name: Dub Karel, Kolodeje
blocked.reason: Prague's largest tree at 734 cm and its oldest at around 550 years, in the deer park below the castle at Kolodeje on private land closed to visitors. Already excluded on the published city page for exactly this reason; recorded here so no future pass rediscovers it and argues the case again.

blocked.name: Lipa u Karlova mostu
blocked.reason: Marked as removed in the register, no girth recorded. Gone.

blocked.name: Turecka liska na Strahove
blocked.reason: Protection removed, no girth recorded in the register, no evidence found that the tree still stands. Not to be confused with the Petrin Turkish hazel, which is a lead rather than a block because its revocation is dated and may have a different cause.

blocked.name: Pavlovnie plstnata na Novem Meste
blocked.reason: Stood in Vrchlickeho sady in front of the main station; protection revoked 15 March 2002 and the tree is recorded as gone.

blocked.name: Dub letni v Podoli
blocked.reason: Marked as removed in the register.

blocked.name: Dub letni Nad Vysinkou
blocked.reason: 393 cm and well placed in Smichov, but the register states it stands in the private garden of house 1259/17. Private land not open to visitors.

blocked.name: Dub uhersky u Palaty
blocked.reason: 460 cm, inside the grounds of the Palata home for the visually impaired. A residential care institution is not a place to send visitors, whatever the gate policy.

blocked.name: Jasan u Starokolinske, Ujezd nad Lesy
blocked.reason: The register records it as standing on private land at house 1144, and it is 20 km east of the centre besides.

blocked.name: Alej osobnosti v Evropske ulici
blocked.reason: Ninety planes along a main road, planted in 2010 and 23 to 32 cm around. An avenue, not a collectible point, and young.

blocked.name: Stromoradi lip v ulici Gagarinova
blocked.reason: Eighteen limes in a single row in Suchdol, Prague's largest protected avenue. An avenue: nowhere obvious to stand and nothing singular to have seen.

blocked.name: Skupina jirovcu madalu v obore Hvezda
blocked.reason: Five horse chestnuts planted close together west of the Petrinska brana, said to have been set in the shape of a crown by Maria Theresa after her 1743 coronation. A group rather than one identifiable tree, and Hvezda already has prg_005.

open_questions: The centre is register-poor. Of 118 pamatne stromy rows with coordinates, only six sit within 2.5 km of the centre route and are neither published nor dead, and three of those six are inaccessible or private. Density in Prague 1 has to come from the vyznamne stromy tier, which has 321 entries but only one publisher, Agentura Koniklec, so the two-source rule is the binding constraint rather than supply.

prazskestromy.cz also runs an 8 km QR-code audio trail. It was not opened this pass; its stops are in Praha 4 around Branisovska rather than in the centre, so it is a second-cluster tool, not a centre one.

The 2020 Koniklec printed maps carry a per-tree significance line for both tiers and are a far better index than the website, which paginates nine at a time. Four PDFs, roughly 60,000 characters of text once extracted. Worth importing to data/registers/ as a proper Prague file if Czech cities go further, which would also settle whether the licence permits it; nothing was imported this pass because the licence was not read.

Masaryk's lime (prg_014) has a 100 cm girth disagreement between prazskestromy (249 cm, 2016) and the Koniklec map (349 cm, 2017), which are the same organisation. One of them is a typo and neither is correctable from outside.
